beats: Aeolus hosts Odysseus for a month and listens to the story of Troy.
He gives a sealed oxhide bag containing every adverse wind and releases the west wind for Ithaca.
After nine days Ithaca appears, but Odysseus falls asleep at the helm.
The crew opens the bag, believing it contains treasure, and the winds blast them back to Aeolia.
Aeolus refuses further aid, judging Odysseus hated by the gods.

segments.speaker: aeolus
segments.caption: Take this bag of oxhide, Odysseus — every rough wind is bound inside, sewn shut with silver wire. I loose the West Wind only; let it carry you home to Ithaca.
segments.delivery: generous wind-keeper becoming horrified and absolute when the failed guests return

segments.speaker: aeolus
segments.caption: Out of my island — out, worst of living men! You come back cursed; the blessed gods themselves hate you. I give no help to what heaven hunts.
